acip: MA GRUB NA, SHES BYA'I SPYI DANG BYE BRAG GANG RUNG MA YIN PA CHOS CAN, KHYOD YOD PA'I BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD YOD PA YIN, KHYOD YOD PA DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING YOD PA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, shes bya'i spyi dang bye brag gang rung ma yin pa chos can, khyod yod pa'i bye brag yin par thal, khyod yod pa yin, khyod yod pa dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing yod pa yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that that which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of knowable things is characteristic of existence. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider then that thing which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of knowable things. It is so characteristic of existence, Because (1) it is an existing thing; (2) it is related to existence in such a way that to be it is to be existence; and (3) there are many examples of things which are not that thing which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of knowable things, but which are still existing things.
